hypotheses.text: S1-006 review H1: the remote rule confirms hybrid/on-site postings because the office check matches only exact phrases, the title remote check accepts any 'Remote' word, title negation is unchecked and 'remote-first' alone confirms. Hypothesis: a two-tier office check (explicit office statements exclude; any bare office word - hybrid not followed by cloud/IT, on-site, in office, in person, office-based - blocks confirmation into needs-review), negation (non-remote, not ... remote) checked in title and text, a title 'Remote' accepted only as a label (bracketed, separated or 100%/fully), and 'remote-first' no longer confirming, make all 16 reviewer probe rows non-main and leave 0 of the sample's office-mentioning postings in the main catalog.

S1-006 re-review: tier 2 lists office phrases one by one, so office wording without 'in' (work from our London office, commute, relocation, HQ, work from home N days, partially remote), Unicode hyphens (U+2011, soft hyphen) and a leading 'Remote-First' title still confirm. Hypothesis: folding U+00AD and U+2010-U+2015/U+2212 before matching, making ANY office vocabulary block confirmation (bare office(s) except home office, commut*, relocat*, HQ/headquarters, partially remote, work from home <n>, in person, onsite, hybrid), and accepting a title Remote label only when bracketed or followed by the end or a spaced separator, sends all 18 second-review rows out of the main catalog, keeps the existing 39 table rows unchanged, and leaves 0 office-vocabulary postings of the 100-job sample in the main catalog.
